verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers session creation, decisions, webhooks, SDKs and manual review in the Customer Portal. None of it documents data retention windows or an API for deleting or redacting collected PII. Data governance is a fair axis for an identity-verification service, so the lack of evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control what happens to collected identity data — documented retention windows and a redaction or deletion API that scrubs PII on demand
